only_writer_guards.claim: The integration has no write path other than dispatch: the machine offers no setter, its accessors hand out deep copies, and one answer() call is exactly one dispatch.
only_writer_guards.note: The compiled machine keeps its private fields as own properties (a TypeScript compile detail), so the only-writer property is a contract plus these structural checks, not a runtime seal. The integration never touches them, and the guard proves the accessors copy.

payload_contract.claim: Every one of the 18 built payloads passes the session machine's own structural check, and the validated object is identical to the built payload: no adapter, no coercion.

scripted_session_18.claim: An 18-type scripted session answered only through dispatch, plus one deliberately incomplete case per completed-type group, serialises and deserialises to identical answers.

component_term_gaps.resolution_owner: N22-A (data/terms.json) or N22-B (components.ts). Reported, never silently allowlisted by this lint.
component_term_gaps.rule: A component must render only labels the shipped bank can resolve. Keys the component harness had to invent a scratch term for are, by definition, ARIA names the shipped data/terms.json cannot translate yet.

rendered_names.rule: The rendered aria_name of every field equals the term text the registry key resolves to (the N22-B render fixtures). This lint re-reads that record; it does not re-render.

aria_term_keys.rule: Every dotted *_key / term_keys[] / feedback_keys{} in data/response_types.json must resolve in data/terms.json; the label bank is term-keyed, never a literal.

english_in_input_terms.limits: A denylist over whole words with {placeholders} removed and the physical key caps allowlisted. It catches English UI vocabulary, not English phrasing; it is a mechanical signal, not a language detector.

literal_unit_strings.rule: No string literal in src/inputs/*.ts may contain a standalone unit symbol from data/terms.json unit_grammar.elements. Term keys, {placeholders} and the percentage basis notation are allowlisted; identifiers are tokenised whole, so min_length is not the unit min.

not_claimed: Not a translation-quality review: the lint proves key resolution and the absence of declared English words, not that every Latvian sentence reads well.
Not a screen-reader acceptance claim: that is N33.
